title: Option 6b: IMP-6 and the epic-close checks
description: Ratified 2026-10-21. IMP-6 (coordinator-decisions-ruling-round-2.md, D-22): an act with no matching act_signed event is anomalous. Not built yet.
acceptance_criteria: An IMP-6 check that compares the acts on disk with act_signed events in logs/events.jsonl, deduplicated per TELEMETRY-PROVENANCE-A, and reports raw and distinct counts.
One command the coordinator runs at every epic close that runs attest.py forks, warrant.py reconcile and the IMP-6 check, and prints one report.
It computes and reports only; nothing gates or weighs (IMP-7, PR-022 clause 4), pinned by a test.
The suite passes via goal_mode. Do not edit CLAUDE.md. Hand off to verifier.
